report.method: Original RGBA pixels read after existing clipRects; major two boot components plus bounded torso/cap foreground; virtual source512 ground460; source scale displayHeight/512. All 720 frame diagnostic contact sheets visually inspected. Non-idle lunge, rotation, recoil, death and one-foot contact treated as action pose changes instead of automatic defects.

notes: Attack follow-through can turn the whole character away; this is the original intentional strike/rotation sequence rather than runtime flip inconsistency.
Rifle-spear B standing arm/weapon angle changes, but isolated anatomical anchors remain stable after registration.
Kirkhammer A sword tip and Chikage A trailing blade contaminate whole-foot-band bounding boxes. Major boot components remove these false positives.
Walk and attack poses deliberately alter footprint, including raised feet; automatic source-centroid centering would remove lunges or produce new jumps.
Common skin offsets were proposed for review but rejected; only confirmed idle0 relative placement errors were corrected.

limitations: This pixel/atlas audit is distinct from actual browser playback; root performs browser verification.
A maximum drift under 2px checks anatomical registration, not artistic quality of every independent generated pose.
Original artwork was retained; no bitmap edits, additional artwork or changes to animation frame sequences were made.

browserTemporalMeasurement.method: Actual JPEG screenshots, visible stage left-border localization for scroll compensation; brown/neutral foreground in expected lower-foot region excludes teal backdrop/shadow; two substantial horizontal foot runs averaged. Integer-pixel photographic measurement, not source-alpha exactness.

report.allGenericFacingInspected: All eighty poses face right in source; walking weight transfer, attack reach, hit recoil and death collapse are intentional and preserved. Idle clothing/feet pixel medians are not actor roots; no unsupported center-of-mass recentering was applied.

actualBrowserMeasurement.visualConclusion: Actual gallery photos visibly move beast feet toward the same shadow after origin correction. The idle body is intact with no new cut parts or stray fragments. Old paws visibly float above the shadow; new paws reach/overlap the upper shadow area.
actualBrowserMeasurement.method: Approximate actual JPEG paw foreground and dark teal shadow segmentation; fixed same viewport/same visible stage, integer pixels. Green line is foreground foot bottom; red line is shadow top.
limitations: This is an idle still-image comparison; parent separately verified all16pose relative coordinates and UI playback.
JPEG color masks approximate visible boundaries and are not exact source alpha measurements.

actualBrowser.coverage: Public preview controls used for idle, both movement directions, three weapon attacks, hit, death, idle restoration and weapon transform. Most timed attack screenshots show idle/recovery, not a guaranteed intermediate attack frame. All 800 source frames were reviewed independently in contact sheets and pixel checks. Earlier cached-runtime playback is retained separately in browser/pre-cache-reload and excluded from final corrected runtime coverage.

originRevalidation.scope: Generic skins revalidation after beast originY432/512; thirty weapon form data and renderer logic unchanged.
